messages:
maria: I pushed draft relnotes for v0.9.4 (PR #4123). Need quick review: SDK snippets, migration note for embed streaming removal, and Known Issues. Can people review before EOD?
sam: on it. Do we still call out embed streaming removal?
maria: yes, short blurb + migration steps. Update Go/Python snippets to client.embed.
alex: Ill update Python snippets. What's the new response shape?
liz: sample: ```python
resp = client.embed(model='rwd-mini-embed-1', input='doc')
print(resp['embedding'][:8])
``` Remove streaming examples.
sam: Go snippets updated in branch, pushed commit 5f3a. docs-bot: CI?
docs-bot: CI: docs-lint passed; snippet-tests failed (timeout).
maria: @liz can you run snippet-tests locally?
liz: increased snippet-test timeout to 10s, fixed. Pushing patch.
alex: found broken anchor in migration guide -> fixed.
maria: Known Issue draft: "embed-streaming deprecation: streaming endpoint removed 2026-04-01; client.embed_stream calls return 410. Use client.embed or websocket proxy for streaming."
sam: add fallback snippet: ```js
try { await client.embed_stream(...) } catch (e) { if (e.status === 410) { await client.embed(...); } else { throw e } }
```
liz: note for Dedicated customers: auto-migration for older runtimes; contact enterprise-support@redwood.ai
maria: aiming to merge by 17:00 PT. Tagging @alex for sign-off.
alex: sign-off pending docs-bot green.
docs-bot: CI: all checks passed. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.prod.redwood.ai/rc/0.9.4/docs-relnotes
maria: preview looks good. Fixed minor hyphenation in "KV cache" paragraph.
sam: pushed final fixes. maria: merging at 16:45 PT. :tada:
